slides.headline: Your best sales page is a project you already finished.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: AI will happily make up numbers for you.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Pick a project
slides.card: Ask me 8 questions about a project I finished: the problem, what I did, the result.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Add real numbers
slides.card: Here are my facts: [before, after, time, money]. List only what they prove. Add nothing.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Write the story
slides.card: Write a 150-word case study: problem, what I did, result. Use only my facts. Plain English.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Ask for approval
slides.card: Write a short message asking my client to approve this case study and share one sentence.
slides.note: No client name without their OK.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Make 3 formats
slides.card: Turn this into a LinkedIn post, a short email and a 3-line website blurb. Keep the facts the same.
slides.note: Read every draft before you publish.

slides.headline: Which project will you use?
slides.sub: Comment it below. Daily AI workflows.

scenes.headline: Your video has answers. Ask for them.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here is a video transcript: [paste]. Using only this transcript: what does the speaker say about [topic]? Quote the line. If it isn't covered, say 'not in the video'. Then list what they skipped.

scenes.note: Remove private details before you paste.
scenes.text: Save this for the next long video.
